SCOPE: the Ottoman mahalle/koy avariz akcesi vakfi - the endowment constituted for one fiscal community unit to meet its avariz, nuzul and kurekci-bedeli share and, in practice, its collective needs. NOT the avariz hane (a fiscal accounting unit) and NOT the avariz tax. Named avariz vakiflari appear in the Istanbul and Ayntab court records as the holder of specific assets. Kars 174: a bakery and serhane are proved to lie within Mercan Aga mahalle's hane-i avariz and another waqf and a second quarter's residents are barred from interfering. Kars 181-182: an arsa is 'Gulcamii Mahallesi avariz vakfina ait olan arsa', sold to the trustee by istiglal and leased on at 900 akce a year. Kıvrım's Tablo 1 lists nine Ayntab mahalle funds by name with their trustee and their capital. The idiom 'vakfa ait' / 'mevkuf' is the tradition's own, hence articulated. MEDIUM, NOT HIGH, AND THE REASON IS DOCTRINAL: in Hanafi law the corpus is not owned by a person at all, so 'holds property as the entity' is the analyst's description of what the transactions show, not what the deeds assert. THIS ROW TAKES A STRONGER VALUE THAN waqf_khayri LP2=P (low, on Kuran 2011) AND A REVIEWER SHOULD SEE THAT: the difference is that Kuran describes waqf doctrine while these four work registers in which the fund transacts.

SCOPE: the Ottoman mahalle/koy avariz akcesi vakfi - the endowment constituted for one fiscal community unit to meet its avariz, nuzul and kurekci-bedeli share and, in practice, its collective needs. NOT the avariz hane (a fiscal accounting unit) and NOT the avariz tax. The fund appears as a party, through its mutevelli, and both wins and loses. Kıvrım 38-39: the Tovbe mahalle trustee proves an unpaid 36-kurus debt against the deceased's children's guardian; the Tarlayiatik trustee is non-suited on the heir's oath that there is no estate, then proves a tannery shop and the court orders the 20 kurus paid to the waqf. Kars 174: the inter-quarter dispute over the bakery and serhane is decided and the intruders enjoined; Kars 183-184: trustees sue on debts, and an account dispute between an outgoing and an incoming trustee is settled on witnesses. CAVEAT, AND IT IS THE begijnhof LP3 CAVEAT: standing is always exercised through the mutevelli, and Kars 183 says in terms that 'mutevelli de diger alacaklilar gibi bir alacaklidir'. If standing is read as running through the trustee personally rather than through the institution this cell drops to P. Coded 1 because the judgment runs to the waqf ('vakfa ait 20 kurusu odemesi istenmistir'), not to the man.

SCOPE: the Ottoman mahalle/koy avariz akcesi vakfi - the endowment constituted for one fiscal community unit to meet its avariz, nuzul and kurekci-bedeli share and, in practice, its collective needs. Kars 2020, 183 and Kıvrım 2019, 39 both write that 'vakif alacaginin diger alacaklardan da farkli bir imtiyaz hakki yoktu' - the waqf's claim carried no privilege over other claims. That is about the waqf AS CREDITOR of a dead borrower's estate, not about whether the arrangement's creditors rank ahead of the beneficiaries' personal creditors IN THE CORPUS, which is what AP1 asks. Both sentences also descend from one upstream (Akgunduz, Osmanli Tatbikatinda Vakif Muessesesi, 228-229), so they are one statement quoted twice. .NR.

SCOPE: the Ottoman mahalle/koy avariz akcesi vakfi - the endowment constituted for one fiscal community unit to meet its avariz, nuzul and kurekci-bedeli share and, in practice, its collective needs. NOT the avariz hane (a fiscal accounting unit) and NOT the avariz tax. THE FORM IS FOUNDER-ENDOWED AND THE FOUNDERS ARE NAMED, so AP4 applies rather than being .NA. Kars's Tablo II gives the vakif for two dozen Istanbul quarter funds - Cenan Hatun binti Abdulvehhab 43,000 akce, Emine Hatun binti Serefuddin selling her house and endowing the price, Fatima binti Himmet 5,000 akce, a widow endowing a third of her husband's estate, Armenian women endowing inherited plots. Kıvrım 37 gives six named Ayntab donors from 10 to 200 kurus. The corpus passes to the mutevelli and out of the founder's patrimony. TWO DOCUMENTED QUALIFICATIONS, RECORDED AND NOT CODED AS P: (i) Kıvrım 37 has Ayni Hatun and another woman endow their houses reserving occupancy for life, the sale to follow their death; (ii) Gürsoy 2019, 112-113 shows that a waqf constituted by bequest (vasiyet) is not binding while the founder lives and may be revoked at will - 22 of her 109. THAT SECOND FACT IS CODED AT TS3, NOT HERE, because entering it twice would count one datum as two (the discipline applied to commenda AP1/AP2). P WAS CONSIDERED AND DECLINED: the census reserves P for structural half-presence within one arrangement, not for heterogeneity across instances of a type. DISCLOSURE: AP4 currently reads 1x2 and .NA x16, so P and 0 are its zero-instance values and its own vocabulary note says the column has no discriminating power until a founder-endowed form takes a value other than 1. I computed that zero-instance set before writing this cell and I am aware that P would have relieved it. FALSIFICATION CONDITION: if a reviewer holds that a type may take P where its instances divide, this cell should move to P and TS3 should be re-read with it.

SCOPE: the Ottoman mahalle/koy avariz akcesi vakfi - the endowment constituted for one fiscal community unit to meet its avariz, nuzul and kurekci-bedeli share and, in practice, its collective needs. NOT the avariz hane (a fiscal accounting unit) and NOT the avariz tax. The fund outlives its officers and its founders. Küçük 155, 161: the Kirkcesme defter runs 1249/1834 to 1284/1867 across ten named trustees, with the capital and its nema handed on and audited at each change. Kars 174: trustees are replaced on death, on departure for the hajj, on grounds of age ('ihtiyardir deyu') and for neglect, with the debtors' accounts drawn up at the handover. Gürsoy tracks avariz waqfs in one court from 1491 to 1828 and shows later additions (zam) made to funds decades after constitution. 'Ebediyen' is the tradition's own word for the detention of the corpus, hence articulated. NOT INDEPENDENT OF waqf_khayri TS1=1: both rest on the perpetuity of the waqf, one structure seen twice.

SCOPE: the Ottoman mahalle/koy avariz akcesi vakfi - the endowment constituted for one fiscal community unit to meet its avariz, nuzul and kurekci-bedeli share and, in practice, its collective needs. NOT the avariz hane (a fiscal accounting unit) and NOT the avariz tax. A perpetual endowment with no term. The purpose survives the levy that occasioned it: Kars 167 and Kıvrım 36 both record that once the avariz lost its importance the income continued to be spent on the quarter's needs.

SCOPE: the Ottoman mahalle/koy avariz akcesi vakfi - the endowment constituted for one fiscal community unit to meet its avariz, nuzul and kurekci-bedeli share and, in practice, its collective needs. NOT the avariz hane (a fiscal accounting unit) and NOT the avariz tax. HALF-PRESENT BY MODE OF CONSTITUTION, AND THIS IS THE ROW'S SHARPEST CELL. Gürsoy 112-113: under Ottoman waqf law a waqf founded by bequest is not binding while the founder lives and he may revoke (rücû) at any time, with a worked case - Bevvap Hasan Bey endows 300 kurus at 15 per cent in 1704, revokes in 1705 and redirects the money into real property, then adds to the foundation in 1708 and again by six zeyl to 1713. Twenty-two of her 109 waqfs were constituted this way (thirteen of 203 at the Davudpasa court). A completed inter vivos waqf is irrevocable. Kıvrım 37 adds the softer case of a life-occupancy reservation. MEDIUM, NOT HIGH, AND THE LIMIT IS NAMED: Gürsoy states the rule and gives the case for her corpus of 109, of which 38 are avariz waqfs and 22 are testamentary, but she does not say whether any one waqf is both, so no case identified as an AVARIZ waqf is shown revoked. DIVERGES FROM waqf_khayri TS3=0 (low, on [verify]) and on better evidence.

SCOPE: the Ottoman mahalle/koy avariz akcesi vakfi - the endowment constituted for one fiscal community unit to meet its avariz, nuzul and kurekci-bedeli share and, in practice, its collective needs. NOT the avariz hane (a fiscal accounting unit) and NOT the avariz tax. The founder's sart binds and is enforced - Kars 175-176 records conditions written into deeds precisely so that later parties cannot interfere, and Küçük 151 makes the trustee personally liable for any spending from the principal. Against that, Kıvrım 36 records that once the avariz lost its importance 'bu maksatla kurulmus olan vakiflarin gelirlerinin de koy veya mahalle heyetleri kararıyla uygun yerlere sarf edilmesi usulu getirilmistir' - the practice came in of the income being spent where the village or quarter council decided. That is a real internal power over the application of income, so half-present. LOW, AND THE REASON IS PROVENANCE: the council sentence is Kıvrım's, reproduced by Kars 168, and both descend from Ipsirli's DIA article on avariz vakfi. One statement, quoted twice, with no coded instance behind it. Note also that the passive 'usulu getirilmistir' does not say who introduced the practice.

SCOPE: the Ottoman mahalle/koy avariz akcesi vakfi - the endowment constituted for one fiscal community unit to meet its avariz, nuzul and kurekci-bedeli share and, in practice, its collective needs. NOT the avariz hane (a fiscal accounting unit) and NOT the avariz tax. Gürsoy 105: several separate endowments made for one quarter's needs are gathered into the avariz sandigi and form one fund. Kirkcesme is one corpus of 6,280 kurus with an annual nema of 942 (Küçük 154). One pool. THE SCOPING DECISION IS DOING WORK HERE AND MUST BE VISIBLE. Kıvrım 39 shows Ammu mahalle in Ayntab divided into NINE bolük/hane, each with its own trustee and its own separate cash (145, 110, 53.5, 68, 48, 102, 151, 128 and 52 kurus, totalling 857.5), and Alineccar into two. Read at mahalle level that is several-accounts and this row would span both values of CI1. The type row therefore scopes the arrangement to the FISCAL COMMUNITY UNIT whose avariz share the fund exists to meet, which is the mahalle where the mahalle carries one avariz hane and the bolük where it carries several; the entity-locator rule of 2026-08-31 then returns each fund as a whole arrangement by its own final clause. A REVIEWER WHO SCOPES THE ROW TO THE MAHALLE GETS several-accounts AND A SUB-POOL FORM, and under logbook 1's standing prohibition no entity-shielding or legal-personality claim could then rest on it until the sub-pool audit is run. See also the CI1 well-formedness flag of 2026-08-31 (ii): 'how many pools' and 'how did the pool come to exist' are two questions, and an aggregating chest is exactly the case that shows it.

SCOPE: the Ottoman mahalle/koy avariz akcesi vakfi - the endowment constituted for one fiscal community unit to meet its avariz, nuzul and kurekci-bedeli share and, in practice, its collective needs. NOT the avariz hane (a fiscal accounting unit) and NOT the avariz tax. Stated as the operative principle in three register series and quoted from the deeds. Kars 179: 'Vakfedilen gayr-i menkul ve para hicbir suretle azalmamak sarti ile' - the endowed property and money on condition that they be diminished in no way whatever. Küçük 151: expenditure must absolutely be from the profit obtained, the principle being adopted that none be made from the principal, with indemnity (tazmin) enforced even against the officials who collect the avariz akcesi. Gürsoy 110: the trustee's most important duty is to keep the endowed principal undiminished, and a deed provides for his dismissal if he lends without security. ONE DOCUMENTED BREACH, WHICH IS THE RULE BEING ENFORCED BY BEING RECORDED: the 1844 Kirkcesme account carries 55 kurus taken 'vakif paradan noksan' (Küçük 154). NOT INDEPENDENT OF waqf_khayri CI2=1: one doctrine, two rows.

SCOPE: the Ottoman mahalle/koy avariz akcesi vakfi - the endowment constituted for one fiscal community unit to meet its avariz, nuzul and kurekci-bedeli share and, in practice, its collective needs. NOT the avariz hane (a fiscal accounting unit) and NOT the avariz tax. The decision-maker is the mutevelli and he is insulated from the fund's outcomes. His pay is a fixed sum: 150 kurus at Kirkcesme against a 942-kurus nema (Küçük 154), and in the Burdur deed a stipulated 75 akce out of a stipulated 375 akce of ribh (Kars 176) - a fixed figure, because the deed fixes the rate. When a properly made loan goes bad the loss falls on the fund and not on him: Kars 183-184 has trustees suing insolvent estates, being met by the heir's oath and being non-suited. WHAT HE IS EXPOSED TO IS BREACH, NOT OUTCOME: indemnity for spending from the principal (Küçük 151), dismissal for lending without rehn or kefil (Gürsoy 110). A NEAR MISS RECORDED IN FULL: I first read the fixed salary against the personal liability as no upside plus real downside, which would have given LR2=coupled with LR6=downside-only - and downside-only is a zero-instance value in this census, which I had computed before writing any cell. Re-reading the same pages returned it: fault liability is not outcome exposure. Agreement with waqf_khayri LR2=veiled is not independent evidence.

SCOPE: the Ottoman mahalle/koy avariz akcesi vakfi - the endowment constituted for one fiscal community unit to meet its avariz, nuzul and kurekci-bedeli share and, in practice, its collective needs. NOT the avariz hane (a fiscal accounting unit) and NOT the avariz tax. Nobody holds a stake whose return could be proportional. The nema is applied to the heads the deed fixes - at Kirkcesme 47 kurus 4 para to the nazir, 50 to the hafiz for the Ramazan hatim and teravih, 200 to the funerals of the quarter's poor, 272 to the tax debts of its poor, 150 to the mutevelli, 100 to the water conduits (Küçük 154). Kars 175-176 shows the same shape in the deeds: so many akce to this, the remainder to the quarter's avariz. Fixed claims throughout.

SCOPE: the Ottoman mahalle/koy avariz akcesi vakfi - the endowment constituted for one fiscal community unit to meet its avariz, nuzul and kurekci-bedeli share and, in practice, its collective needs. NOT the avariz hane (a fiscal accounting unit) and NOT the avariz tax. The arrangement does not mutualise a member-specific hazard across its members: it is a corpus given by outsiders whose income relieves a liability that lies on the residents. Kıvrım 37 names six individual donors and opens his section 'Bazi hayir sahipleri tarafindan, kendi mahalleleri halkini avariz vergi yukunden kurtarmak icin' - some charitable persons, to relieve the people of their own quarter. Donor and beneficiary are disjoint. WHAT IS POOLED IS THE SHORTFALL, NOT THE FUND: Kars 167 and Kıvrım 36 both have the residents paying the remainder by sharing it among themselves when the income does not suffice - and that pooling attaches to the tax, which this row does not code. This reproduces the loss census's own finding at avariz_fund (logbook 4, 2026-08-19 (iv) and (v)); the agreement is not independent, and the reader should know that the two censuses read the same pages of the same authors. LR5 propagates .NA.

The classes named in the deeds are 'mahalle fukarasi' (Kars 176: Cenan Hatun's 500 akce a year for the avariz of the poor of Hasan Halife mahalle), 'suleha-yi fukara' (Kars 177), 'mahalle sukkani' (Kars 177), and in Küçük 152 'odeme kabiliyeti olmayan kisiler'. SCOPE: the Ottoman mahalle/koy avariz akcesi vakfi - the endowment constituted for one fiscal community unit to meet its avariz, nuzul and kurekci-bedeli share and, in practice, its collective needs. NOT the avariz hane (a fiscal accounting unit) and NOT the avariz tax. THE ROW'S MAIN RESULT, AND IT SEPARATES THIS FORM FROM waqf_khayri ON A SUBSTANTIVE VALUE. Kıvrım 38 has the Ayntab residents choosing their trustee and registering him at court, with two cases from his own sicils: the people of Kanalici mahalle come to court and name Seyyid Ibrahim; the residents of Kayser mahalle name Molla Ebuderda, with seven further appointment references in his n.29. Kıvrım 40-41 adds the 1706 case in which, after abuses in apportioning the levy, the townspeople by common agreement had each quarter elect a trustworthy vekil and register him at court - thirty-eight named in his Tablo 2. Kars 173-174 reports the same norm and documents four trustee replacements (Kizilbey, Akseki, Eregli, Mufti Ali Celebi). WARNING, AND IT IS THE ONE THIS BATCH KEEPS MEETING: the NORM sentence in Kars 173 is Kıvrım's sentence with the city swapped, and Kars cites Kıvrım; they are one witness on the norm. What is genuinely Kıvrım's own is the Ayntab case evidence, and what is genuinely Kars's own is the Istanbul replacement evidence. COUNTER-EVIDENCE, WHICH IS WHY THIS IS MEDIUM AND NOT HIGH: many deeds name the trustee themselves - Kars 176 has Cenan Hatun's own mutevelli, and Gürsoy 109, 115 shows founders appointing trustees, sometimes their own minor sons under a guardian, and from the nineteenth century salaried officials of the evkaf administration. Governance is therefore founder-fixed at constitution and collective in succession, and MG2 admits no such value.

NOT the avariz hane (a fiscal accounting unit) and NOT the avariz tax. A hayri foundation with a defined local beneficiary class. Kars 164 gives the definition the sources work with - a waqf is constituted 'dini, ictimai ve hayri gaye ile' - and closes at 185 by calling the avariz vakfi 'hayri bir kurulus'. The clause that would support it - Kars 169 and Kıvrım 37, 'Bu vakiflar mahalle halkinin katkilariyla kurulmus' - is one sentence with one origin (Kıvrım, copied by Kars, who cites him), and Kıvrım's own donor list contradicts it; the loss census reached the same conclusion from Çizakça's Bursa series. Küçük 152 does describe the funds as 'bir cesit sosyal dayanisma orgutlenmesi', which is the reading held open here at medium. DISCLOSURE: mutual-provision is a zero-instance value in this census and I had computed the zero-instance set before writing this cell. It is declined anyway, and the same value IS coded on bruderschaft_salzburg where the source supports it - which is the contrast a reviewer should use to judge whether the gap or the sources were driving.

SCOPE: the Ottoman mahalle/koy avariz akcesi vakfi - the endowment constituted for one fiscal community unit to meet its avariz, nuzul and kurekci-bedeli share and, in practice, its collective needs. NOT the avariz hane (a fiscal accounting unit) and NOT the avariz tax. HALF-PRESENT, ON TWO NAMED CASES. Kıvrım 37: Yakub and Seyyid Halil of Kanalici mahalle each endowed to their quarter's avariz vakfi 'kendi evlerinden avariz alinmamak sarti ile' - on condition that avariz not be taken from their own houses (GSS 34-157 and 25-28). A founder buying a personal fiscal exemption through the form is legal-status arbitrage for a principal in the plainest sense. LOW: two cases out of dozens, and the form is not built for it. NOT INDEPENDENT of the loss census's reading of the same two cases as 'a purchase, not a mutualisation' (logbook 4, 2026-08-19 (iv)).

SCOPE: the Ottoman mahalle/koy avariz akcesi vakfi - the endowment constituted for one fiscal community unit to meet its avariz, nuzul and kurekci-bedeli share and, in practice, its collective needs. NOT the avariz hane (a fiscal accounting unit) and NOT the avariz tax. Registration is constitutive of everything we can see.
